slides.text: We rebuilt the sync job three times that spring, and every rebuild passed the same test suite before we shipped it.

citations.quote: We rebuilt the sync job three times that spring, and every rebuild passed the same test suite before we shipped it.

slides.text: Then it didn't. A batch job stalled overnight, and when I finally traced it the next morning, the real failure had needed nineteen retries before the connection recovered on its own — a number the twelve-retry ceiling never gave it the chance to reach, so the job just gave up and silently marked the batch as done anyway.

slides.text: We raised the ceiling, added a log line for every retry past the old limit, and moved on.

slides.text: The twelve-retry number stuck around in three other places in the codebase for another year before anyone found and fixed those too.
